description: Metadata-only expectations for seven real pinned public Cask taps. The parent verified the pins on 2026-09-29 via GitHub APIs and source reads: no Ruby executed, no payloads downloaded. Expected statuses derive from reading the pinned source files; they are hypotheses recorded before the final runs, kept unchanged. check_sources.py enforces status, inventory, and provenance; it does not assert the descriptive reason/codes strings. Vendor payload download budget for this matrix: 0. Final actual records (2026-09-29, normal mode, both hosts): every source's real Rust import, strict offline checker, and Nix derivation evaluation returned 0 with zero payloads — Linux 30 records, 13 eligible / 17 excluded (public-import-linux-final-evidence.tar.gz); macOS 30 records, 7 eligible / 23 excluded (public-import-macos-final-evidence.tar.gz and public-import-macos-final-summary.json; first three sources ran before the GitHub rate-limit reset, the last four after it). Summary: docs/verification/public-taps.md; raw archives at the pinned baseline commit 913dedb3131a3f1db4c3ab385e3dc4ca495c21f3. Per-entry outcomes are in the archive summary rows; the per-source 'actual' objects below are concise counts plus evidence links.

policy.import: No imports execute here. Validation commands are documented in tools/public-tap-check/README.md.
policy.license_rule: Record 'unspecified' when no LICENSE is detectable at the pin. Do not assume a license.
policy.codes_note: The 'reason' and 'codes' strings in entries are descriptive source notes recorded for review. check_sources.py enforces status, inventory, and provenance, and records reasons in its JSON evidence; it does not assert these code strings.
